definitions.explanation: A performance given as an invited guest with a group or company one does not normally belong to, as when a conductor, actor, or musician appears with another ensemble or theater. Takes する to mean to make such an appearance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{指揮者|しきしゃ}→指揮者：06565_shikisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{客演|きゃくえん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A famous conductor will make a guest appearance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{客演|きゃくえん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A singer from overseas will make a guest appearance in this performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{劇団|げきだん}→劇団：20045_gekidan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{客演|きゃくえん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{主役|しゅやく}→主役：04199_shuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じた→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧。
examples.english: She made a guest appearance with another theater company and played the lead role.

notes:
Used of the performing arts — concerts, theater, opera, ballet. The guest is invited from outside the regular company for a particular production.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {客演|きゃくえん}⟦{指揮者|しきしゃ}→指揮者：06565_shikisha⟧: guest conductor
- {客演|きゃくえん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appear as a guest performer
- {客演|きゃくえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to welcome a guest performer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出演|しゅつえん}→出演：11732_shutsuen⟧: appearing/performing (in general) — does not imply being an outside guest
- ⟦{共演|きょうえん}→共演：11676_kyouen⟧: co-starring — performing together with others, from the performers' point of view
